description: Connect this agent to a Glitchless Cloud workspace, so it can create games, read any of them, design their dashboards and make share links. Returns a link and a code: show both to the person and ask them to approve it in the browser. Then call this tool again (or any other) — once it's approved, this server uses the workspace key right away, and keeps it for later sessions.

game.description: The game, by name or id, when signed in to a workspace (glitchless_list_games lists them); later calls keep it. With a key for one game (gl_sk_…), a call that names another game is refused: sign in to the workspace to reach every game.

name: glitchless_sign_in
title: Sign in
